territory_rows.name: 01 THE OPEN FLOOR
territory_rows.concept: What you can spend is the open floor of a room. Everything already held back is the wall around it.
territory_rows.metaphor: AN OPEN ROOM SEEN IN PLAN (the loggia brief drawn from above: open, not unfinished)
territory_rows.primary_object: THE OPEN FLOOR — a drawn room whose open area is the safe-to-spend value and whose wall mass is the held-back total
territory_rows.composition_logic: CENTER_STAGE field; the room spans the stage on the + axis; the door, the breakdown button and the + share that axis.
territory_rows.mobile_logic: 393×852: room 300×300 on the axis inside the 340 stage; single screen, no pagination at parent density.
territory_rows.desktop_logic: Not authored (founder selection first). Note: a plan drawing scales without recomposition; the 560 stage would allow named walls at rest.
territory_rows.brand_fit: Architectural lifestyle + plaster / travertine + editorial restraint; the room is the JURNL world drawn as information.
territory_rows.experience_fit: “One open answer”, “the room stays open, not unfinished”, “more air”, “why stays closed” (the door is closed).

territory_rows.name: 02 THE PLAIN ANSWER
territory_rows.concept: The page is one plain sentence that answers the question, set into stone.
territory_rows.metaphor: AN INSCRIPTION — the answer cut into travertine: still, plain, permanent-feeling
territory_rows.primary_object: THE ANSWER SENTENCE — generated from the breakdown, the figure as its second line
territory_rows.composition_logic: CENTER_STAGE field; text keeps its own left alignment inside the centred field (the field is centred, not every element).
territory_rows.mobile_logic: 393×852: display 104px figure, 32px sentence, inline amount chips 24px tall; long sentences paginate atomically (the sentence is one panel).
territory_rows.desktop_logic: Not authored. A sentence scales by measure (line length) — desktop would need its own measure, not a stretched column.
territory_rows.brand_fit: The JURNL voice made visible: quietly assured, clear, direct; display serif + tracked sans; travertine.
territory_rows.experience_fit: “One word or figure. Wide tracking. Short.”, “The answer is the parent.”, function label → state → editorial with the question never carrying meaning.

territory_rows.name: 03 THE OPEN ENVELOPE
territory_rows.concept: One envelope is open: what you can spend. Everything held back is sealed beside it.
territory_rows.metaphor: OPEN AND SEALED ENVELOPES — setting money aside, in JURNL paper, linen and wax
territory_rows.primary_object: THE OPEN ENVELOPE and the slip that carries the safe-to-spend figure
territory_rows.composition_logic: CENTER_STAGE field; the open envelope sits on the + axis; the sealed row spans the stage in equal cells.
territory_rows.mobile_logic: 393×852: open envelope 304 wide on the axis; up to 4 sealed envelopes per row (7 max → a second row or atomic pagination).
territory_rows.desktop_logic: Not authored. Objects keep their size; desktop gains a wider sealed row, not a bigger envelope.
territory_rows.brand_fit: Paper, textile, champagne / wine / blush, botanical language, tactile materiality; avoids the forbidden DARK_BANK_VAULT reading of “safe”.
territory_rows.experience_fit: “One open answer” (the open envelope), “why stays closed” (sealed), F09.HOLD “what is held back”, IX.HOLD “a confirmation, closed”.

JURNL.F09.T01.spatial_logic: Concentric plan view read from the centre outward: the room is cash, the wall ring is what is held back, the open floor is what is clear.
JURNL.F09.T01.primary_zone: The open floor at the centre of a drawn room, figure inscribed on it.
JURNL.F09.T01.visual_hierarchy: Figure on the floor → state line → proportion of wall to floor → door → breakdown → legend and question.
JURNL.F09.T01.interaction_emphasis: Spatial inspection: tap a wall course or the door (SEE THE FULL BREAKDOWN) and the walls take their names and amounts in place — same room, the job narrows.
JURNL.F09.T01.information_density: One figure and one proportional drawing; wall courses unnamed until inspected.
JURNL.F09.T01.media_relationship: Perimeter-only imagery (plaster, daylight, olive at the right edge); the drawing itself carries the data.

JURNL.F09.T02.spatial_logic: Linear reading column: one sentence top to bottom, left-aligned inside the centred field.
JURNL.F09.T02.primary_zone: The sentence block in the upper two thirds; the figure is its second line.
JURNL.F09.T02.visual_hierarchy: YOU CAN SPEND → figure → single proportional rule → NOW, AFTER + held-back words → reading → breakdown → question.
JURNL.F09.T02.interaction_emphasis: Inline disclosure: each held-back word opens its amount where it stands; SEE THE FULL BREAKDOWN gives the whole reading.
JURNL.F09.T02.information_density: Words only: one figure, one rule, one word per non-zero held-back field.
JURNL.F09.T02.media_relationship: The answer is set into the material (travertine field); dappled olive shade at the outer frame only.

JURNL.F09.T03.spatial_logic: Object stage in depth: one open object in front and above, the sealed set beneath it in a row — scale and open / closed carry the hierarchy.
JURNL.F09.T03.primary_zone: The open envelope and the slip rising out of it.
JURNL.F09.T03.visual_hierarchy: Slip figure → state stamp → sealed envelopes and their labels → held-back total → breakdown.
JURNL.F09.T03.interaction_emphasis: Object manipulation: tap a sealed envelope to open it (its amount rises on a slip); SEE THE FULL BREAKDOWN opens them all; CHANGE WHAT’S HELD reseals the protected / buffer envelopes.
JURNL.F09.T03.information_density: One figure plus one labelled envelope per non-zero held-back field; amounts sealed.
JURNL.F09.T03.media_relationship: Imagery lives inside the object (flap liner) and in the linen ground; no environment plate.

upstream_scorecard.why: Palette with roles, type pair, hard rules, world traits and forbidden departures are encoded. Positioning lines, audience, voice avoid list and mood statement are not (sprint-stated only). Gate brand check: BRAND_CONTEXT_REQUIRED (audience).
No JURNL contract in the Workspace Experience Brain; JURNL.SAFE_TO_SPEND exists only as a non-material portability sample (“must not be used as build instructions”). Gate: EXPERIENCE_REQUIRED.

F09 brief + expression tree give job, question, signal, emotional role, child jobs and family relationships. Its composition fields are plate-era (left rail, right opening) and superseded by CENTER_STAGE; parent catalog labels drift from code.

Completeness enum and state copy are exact in code. The brief’s UNSTATED intent (“cannot be said yet · one return”) contradicts the runtime (number always shown); F03 and F09 disagree; no recovery actions; LOADING / ERROR undefined; no per-state visual relationships.

Triggers, routes, sheets and mutations are exact. “Why stays closed” is the only parent interaction intent; no grammar for inspecting a held-back item; FF.SEE_WHY_VS_F09 unresolved; back fixed to TODAY.

One formula owner, every field and source defined, zero-bands-hidden rule. Functional defects flagged, not blocking concepting: BILLS BEFORE NEXT INCOME label ≠ formula, LOAN as cash, CARD ADDED expenses, purchase reserve unreachable, WHY omits trip / purchase.
Mobile CENTER_STAGE, safe zone, nav, pagination and back are exact. Nothing F09-specific; the occupancy map’s tablet / desktop entries copy the superseded mobile left rail.

Strong on feeling and restraint (one open answer, a single mark, why stays closed, still, more air; risks: looking empty, copying today’s journal). Its spatial content describes a room photograph (loggia, arch and sea on the right), not a page composition. Every primary object had to be invented.

upstream_verdict.question: DID THE UPSTREAM SYSTEM PRODUCE ENOUGH INTELLIGENCE TO CREATE THREE STRONG TERRITORIES WITHOUT RELYING ON LEGACY UI?
upstream_verdict.summary: Upstream fixed what the page must say, feel and refuse, and was enough to firewall legacy UI completely. It did not supply composition intelligence: the three primary objects (plan-view room, inscribed sentence, open / sealed envelopes) were invented by the territory author from brand materials + the formula + the brief’s abstractions.
